exposure: Multiparous women without previous cesarean section (Robson groups 3 and 4A)
Multiparous women with prelabor cesarean (Robson group 4B)
Nulliparous women with prelabor cesarean (Robson group 2B)
finding: Cesarean section rates after induction of labor differed significantly between nulliparous and multiparous women.
mod_finding: The study found that cesarean section rates were significantly higher among induced nulliparous women compared to induced multiparous women.
